Emma / Alex — looping in a short retention statement and confirming next steps from Legal: 

Short retention statement (for procurement):
- KV cache: ephemeral by default; per-request KV entries retained in memory only for the session lifetime (typical TTL 5–30 minutes); not persisted to disk unless customer explicitly requests snapshotting.
- Logs (operational): retained for 90 days by default; can be configured to 30/90/365 on Dedicated or Private deployments per contract.
- Audit/export: customers may request exports for compliance; retention settings will be reflected in the final DPA and SOW.

Next steps from Redwood legal (high level):
1) We will prepare a Module 2 DPA draft that includes our subprocessor list link and the standard SCC module 2 annex.
2) We'll prepare an answer matrix for the attached GDPR questionnaire and send both documents by EOD Thu (Aug 13).
3) If Greenline needs joint-controller language, that will require a longer negotiation; please flag now to avoid delays.

I'll share the DPA draft link when ready. Alex — looping procurement@greenline.com so Legal has the right contact.
